title: Head - Material Planner
department: Required Qualifications · B.E./B.Tech – Mechanical/Metallurgy/Production/Industrial Engineering · MBA/PGDM in Operations/Supply Chain (preferred) Experience · 10–15 years of experience in material planning, supply chain, or production planning · Minimum 5 years in a leadership role · Experience in downstream steel operations preferred (CR/GAL/CCL/Service Centre) Skills & Competencies · Strong knowledge of steel manufacturing processes · Expertise in MRP, demand forecasting, and inventory optimization · SAP/ERP proficiency · Data-driven decision-making · Team management and stakeholder coordination · Excellent communication and analytical skills · Knowledge of lean, 5S, and continuous improvement tools
jobDescription:
Functional area: 00051511-Material Planner
Function: Required Qualifications · B.E./B.Tech – Mechanical/Metallurgy/Production/Industrial Engineering · MBA/PGDM in Operations/Supply Chain (preferred) Experience · 10–15 years of experience in material planning, supply chain, or production planning · Minimum 5 years in a leadership role · Experience in downstream steel operations preferred (CR/GAL/CCL/Service Centre) Skills & Competencies · Strong knowledge of steel manufacturing processes · Expertise in MRP, demand forecasting, and inventory optimization · SAP/ERP proficiency · Data-driven decision-making · Team management and stakeholder coordination · Excellent communication and analytical skills · Knowledge of lean, 5S, and continuous improvement tools
Responsibility: Roles and Responsibilities A. Material Planning & Control · Develop and manage short-term & long-term material plans aligned with production targets. · Ensure timely availability of raw materials (HR coils, chemicals, consumables, zinc, paints, packing material, etc.). · Optimize inventory levels to avoid stock-outs or excess inventory. · Maintain safety stock norms and monitor consumption trends. B. Production Coordination · Align material plans with daily/weekly/monthly production schedules. · Coordinate with Production, Quality, and Maintenance for planning accuracy. · Manage material allocation for CR, GAL, CCL, Slitting, CTL, and Service Centre operations. C. Supply Chain & Vendor Coordination · Coordinate with Procurement for timely ordering and follow-up. · Monitor supplier performance in terms of delivery timelines and quality. · Liaise with logistics for inbound and outbound material planning. D. Inventory & Warehouse Management · Ensure accurate GRN posting, stock reconciliation, and cycle counting. · Drive continuous improvement in warehouse operations for better space utilization. · Maintain FIFO/FEFO discipline across stores. E. Cost Optimization · Identify opportunities to reduce inventory carrying costs. · Minimize demurrage, detention, and transportation inefficiencies. · Support strategic sourcing decisions with data-driven insights. F. Systems, Data & Reporting · Oversee SAP/ERP-based planning, MRP runs, and inventory dashboards. · Publish daily, weekly, and monthly material planning reports. · Lead digital initiatives like automated planning tools, consumption analytics, etc. G. Compliance & Governance · Ensure adherence to internal controls, audit norms, and safety standards. · Drive compliance with material handling, storage safety, and documentation procedures. H. People & Team Leadership · Lead a team of planners, store executives, and material coordinators. · Develop capability, conduct mentoring, and drive performance management. · Foster collaboration across departments. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) · Raw material availability % · Inventory Turns / Days of inventory · Stock-out incidents · Material accuracy (SAP vs physical) · Forecast accuracy · Demurrage & detention cost · OTIF (On-Time In-Full) material supply · Cost savings through planning optimization
